description: See logins: what the Linux home new agents boot holds, as the toolbox found when it saved that home, and whether linux agents have a Claude login (vibe setup-token's token, kept on the Mac). Without a Claude login, claude_problem says why. It boots nothing, so it answers while the shell is open too. If VibeOS couldn't tell what a home holds, there's no logins field; with no home yet, logins is empty.

result.claude_problem: linux agents have no Claude login yet: run `vibe setup-token`
